```python
import pandas as pd

Vmax = float(row7['Catalytic Constant'])
Km = float(row7['Menten Constant'])
# Convert substrate concentration from mM to M
S_M = S_mM / 1000.0
numerator = Vmax * S_M
denominator = Km + S_M
velocity = numerator / denominator
print('Reaction 7 values:', row7.to_dict())
print('Numerator:', numerator)
print('Denominator:', denominator)
print('Velocity (to four decimal places):', round(velocity, 4))
```
